trigger: The first live cooldowns showed that pausing the client process can overlap either environment stepping or a policy request; the client timer alone cannot identify the overlap.

metric_consequence.episode_wall_time: Retain raw values; they include all cooling pauses.
metric_consequence.client_policy_request_time: Retain raw values and label them upper bounds on model-plus-transport latency because a pause can occur while the client waits for a response.
metric_consequence.thermal_log: Report cooldown count and total seconds per batch without allocating cooldown time to an unobserved request or step phase.
metric_consequence.operational_model_latency: Prefer separately measured warm fixed-observation/native probe latency for model-only engineering comparisons; report closed-loop client request timing only with the upper-bound qualifier.

outcome_metrics: No success, progression, endpoint, action, or semantic-future metric changes.
reason: Subtracting every cooldown from policy time or environment time would fabricate phase attribution not present in the logs.
